prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, logo-brand.
Refine the attached concept into a mature, exceptionally restrained professional app logo. Preserve its central idea: the incoming ECG becomes a runner and then returns to a short ECG.
Radically simplify the amount of drawing while IMPROVING the human figure. Retain an anatomically credible ADULT ATHLETE in a natural dynamic running stride. Sophisticated contemporary sports-identity design, elegant and athletic.
The runner has adult proportions: a SMALL slightly inclined oval head, approximately one seventh the full height of the person, a short neck, clear shoulder and hip rhythm, an elongated torso leaning forward about 15 degrees, a front thigh raised forward with a naturally flexed knee, and a long rear leg extending back. Two bent arms counterbalance the legs and clearly originate at the shoulders. The whole pose feels fluid and capable, with forward momentum. No oversized circular head, disconnected arm, chair-shaped leg, toy figure, stick person or cartoon proportions.
Construct the athlete from only a few economical flowing shapes and deliberate curves. Use a refined selective contour or gently tapered graphic strokes that suggest the essential anatomy, with clear negative space and restrained weight. Remove redundant limb outlines and all small internal details. Small oval head, no facial features, no fingers, no clothing, no shoe details. Keep the figure slender, balanced and effortlessly readable, avoiding thick pill-like segments and bubbly joints.
The ECG is secondary: a short clean baseline with ONE simple small up/down spike on each side, integrating naturally into the runner's trailing and leading foot. No extra wave bumps, no long tails, no baseline behind the body. The runner dominates the identity.
One clean compact composition, about 1.8:1 overall silhouette, centered within a square canvas with generous clear margins. The meaningful silhouette occupies about 76 percent of canvas width.
Color only the symbol with a smooth restrained left-to-right gradient from cyan #20D8F8 to blue #2F7EF6. Crisp flat vector-like artwork. Genuinely transparent RGBA background and transparent negative spaces. No glow, no shadow, no texture, no lighting, no 3D.
No text, initials, lettering, numbers, slogan, tile, border, labels, extra symbols or watermark. Exactly one final refined logo symbol.
